source_row.rationale: Factitious disorder involves intentional falsification or induction of signs or symptoms in the absence of obvious external rewards. Modern DSM-based descriptions emphasize the deceptive behavior and lack of obvious external incentive; proving a specific internal motivation such as wanting a 'sick role' is not required to recognize the pattern.
source_row.source_detail: DSM-5-based definition: intentional production/falsification of symptoms without external incentives; last update 2025-07-07; accessed 2026-08-14.
